acceptance_criteria.details: List, get, create, update, delete procedures all implemented with protectedProcedure base
createProjectInput, updateProjectInput with comprehensive validation (string length, path format, enum values, non-negative numbers)
AppRouter type exported from routers/index.ts enables auto-generated type-safe client via AppRouterClient
ORPCError with NOT_FOUND (404), BAD_REQUEST (400) codes, detected by error message content matching 'not found'

reasons.F015: Provides protectedProcedure base pattern and oRPC routing setup
reasons.F004: Provides ProjectSchema and ProjectIdSchema for validation

discoveries.context: Initial implementation forgot to include id: crypto.randomUUID() in projectRepository.create() call
discoveries.lesson: Always check repository method signatures - especially required fields in create operations
discoveries.prevention: Copy template from F012 project repository exactly, including all required fields in create call

discoveries.discovery: Type casting needed for Zod object to Drizzle Record
discoveries.context: settings field is Zod schema object but Drizzle expects Record<string, unknown>
discoveries.code_example: settings: input.settings as Record<string, unknown> | undefined
discoveries.lesson: Drizzle JSON columns need explicit type cast from Zod-validated objects
discoveries.prevention: Add type cast for all complex object fields when passing to repository

discoveries.discovery: Update handlers must build updateData conditionally
discoveries.context: Only fields that changed should be included in updateData to avoid overwriting undefined fields with null
discoveries.code_pattern:
const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = {};
if (input.data.name !== undefined) updateData.name = input.data.name;
discoveries.lesson: Partial updates require filtering out undefined fields before repository call
discoveries.prevention: Use conditional checks for each field, don't spread input.data directly

patterns_applied.name: PATTERN_REUSE
patterns_applied.how_used: Copied F015 protectedProcedure pattern as base for all procedures
patterns_applied.benefit: Reduced implementation time, ensured consistent error handling and auth context

patterns_applied.name: ZOD_BRANDED_TYPES
patterns_applied.how_used: Used ProjectIdSchema for type-safe project IDs throughout router
patterns_applied.benefit: Prevented mixing project IDs with other string types at compile time

patterns_applied.name: DRIZZLE_TYPE_INFERENCE
patterns_applied.how_used: Router types match repository $inferSelect types for full type chain
patterns_applied.benefit: Type safety from database through API to client

what_worked: Clean implementation following existing procedure pattern from F015
All 4 acceptance criteria met on first attempt (no retries)
36 comprehensive tests covering CRUD, validation, error handling, defaults, and partial updates
No merge conflicts or integration issues
Router integration into appRouter worked smoothly with namespace nesting (projects: projectRouter)
what_could_improve: Repository create signature should be documented or validated at type level - easy to forget the required ID field
Type casting from Zod to Drizzle Record could be abstracted into a helper function to reduce boilerplate
Update handlers have repetitive field-by-field checks - could benefit from a utility to filter changed fields

recommendations.recommendation: Use project.ts as template for all future CRUD routers
recommendations.rationale: Complete example with all error handling, validation, and update logic patterns
recommendations.action: Copy packages/api/src/routers/project.ts, rename entity, swap schema imports, update repository

recommendations.recommendation: Always check repository create() signature before implementing
recommendations.rationale: Different repositories may have different required fields (e.g., id, userId, projectId)
recommendations.action: Review packages/db/src/repositories/<entity>.ts create method before writing router create procedure

recommendations.recommendation: Create reusable type cast helper for Zod-to-Drizzle Record conversion
recommendations.rationale: Settings, config, metadata fields repeat across routers
recommendations.action: Add utility: type ZodToRecord<T extends z.ZodType> = Record<string, unknown>

recommendations.recommendation: Future CRUD routers should have identical test structure to F017
recommendations.rationale: 36 tests provide comprehensive coverage of all CRUD paths, validation, and error handling
